mytime.de.terms: Read 13 Nov 2026. Imprint (mytime.de/impressum, Bünting E-Commerce GmbH & Co. KG): no sentence on copyright, reuse, automated access, crawlers, scraping, price comparison or databases; only photo credits. AGB (mytime.de/agb, sections 1-14): no clause on any of these; section 2a says product displays are non-binding offers. The tool's copy stopped inside 14(3), a courier drop-off clause. Robots: * allows / and disallows only category, category_id, cat, sort, page and page_size parameters and /api/*; Amazonbot is barred from the whole site. Upgrades R4/R5's unknown.
mytime.de.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool (earlier rounds).

anker.com.terms: Terms of Service (anker.com/policies/terms-of-service), read 13 Nov 2026, section 8.2(2): you may not "conduct any systematic or automated data collection on or in relation to Anker's Services—including scraping, data mining, data extraction, data harvesting ... without our express prior written consent"; section 6: you must not "Reproduce, duplicate, copy or otherwise exploit material on Anker's Services for a commercial purpose".

uline.com.terms: Terms and conditions PDF (uline.com/pdf/terms_US.pdf), read 13 Nov 2026: "USE RESTRICTIONS: You may not: (a) scrape, extract, download, or copy the Contents, either manually or using automated tools, including but not limited to web scraping, bots, spiders ... without prior written consent from Uline". Downgrades R4's unknown.
uline.com.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool (earlier rounds).

shop.rewe.de.terms: REWE imprint (rewe.de/service/impressum), read 13 Nov 2026: no clause on copyright, reuse, automated access or price comparison; only image credits. shop.rewe.de/robots.txt refused the fetch tool, so robots could not be read.
